items.prompt:
To 'paraphrase' means to:
A) copy the exact words
B) put it in your own words, keeping the meaning
C) change the meaning
items.answer: B) put it in your own words, keeping the meaning

steps: Own words, same meaning. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) put it in your own words, keeping the meaning

items.prompt:
Good paraphrase of 'Owls hunt at night':
A) Owls hunt at night
B) Owls are active hunters after dark
C) Owls are birds
items.answer: B) Owls are active hunters after dark

steps: Own words, same idea. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Owls are active hunters after dark

items.prompt:
A paraphrase should keep the same:
A) exact words
B) meaning
C) length only

steps: Keep the meaning. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which is NOT a good paraphrase (it changes the meaning) of 'The desert gets little rain'?
A) The desert is very dry
B) Hardly any rain falls in the desert
C) The desert gets a lot of rain
items.answer: C) The desert gets a lot of rain

solution.answer: C) The desert gets a lot of rain

items.prompt:
You hear: 'Honeybees communicate the location of flowers by performing a waggle dance.' The BEST paraphrase is:
A) Honeybees do a dance to tell other bees where flowers are.
B) Honeybees communicate the location of flowers by performing a waggle dance.
C) Bees like to dance for fun.
items.answer: A) Honeybees do a dance to tell other bees where flowers are.

steps: Own words, keeps meaning. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Honeybees do a dance to tell other bees where flowers are.

items.prompt:
Why is paraphrasing a useful skill when listening?
A) It shows you understood the information in your own words
B) It copies the speaker exactly
C) It changes what was said
items.answer: A) It shows you understood the information in your own words

solution.answer: A) It shows you understood the information in your own words
